settings.uncertainty: 2000 paired spatial-block draws, seed 20261017, equal object weights; conditional on the successful sample and this field. Marginal intervals for each bin/method, not a simultaneous trend test or training-seed uncertainty.
settings.coverage: Common successful images: JWST, native NISP, bilinear, bicubic, diffusion, diffusion mean3, ResNet, ResNet-D5; denominator all attempted objects in each bin.
